intro: Boston's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $256/month, up 1.6% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). StorageUnitCosts lists $268 (August 2026). Storage Stats puts the Boston metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $172, up 1.9% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $236. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); Aug 2026 (StorageUnitCosts); Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $128 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $135 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$108.

Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $151 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $158 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$155. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $256, up 1.6% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $268, up 5.5% from a year earlier (Aug 2026). Storage Stats Boston metro non-climate asking rent $172, up 1.9% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Boston alone. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$236.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $363 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$326.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $474 (Sep 2026). StorageUnitCosts $493 (Aug 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$462.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Mattapan (~$154), Roxbury (~$160), Jamaica Plain (~$186) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. South End Boston (~$358) is among the highest.
Boston has about 11 facilities and 0.7 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
